question_summary: Submitter asks whether the civil inspector can approve the excavation shoring setback at Placement Zone 2 near the property line, since the geotechnical report does not clearly address the Section 31 50 00 setback requirement, before backfill and compaction testing proceed.
deadline_text: A response within three days would help us stay ahead of the compaction testing.
routing_rationale: The question concerns an excavation shoring setback requirement under Section 31 50 00, which falls under civil earthwork scope and requires the Civil Engineer's confirmation before inspector sign-off.
